title: Audit Venue workspace — baseline, gaps, and questions
goal: Audit the Venue area to gather a baseline understanding: what exists today, what the area is trying to build, and what is missing/incomplete/needs improvement. Use deep research and sequential thinking; finish with prioritized questions for the owner to answer on how to build or fix each gap. Focus: venue identity, public profiles, bookings, venue operations, and venue kit
